findings.scenario: Set published vaulter.features.blobs to false and run a fresh migrate. 2026_06_13_000009_create_v_blobs_table::up() returns before SchemaBuilder::createTable('blobs'), and Laravel records that migration as applied. 2026_06_13_000012 then creates v_file_revision_blobs with a foreign key to v_blobs and fails because v_blobs was never created. A retry does not run 000009 again. Upgrade migration №2 does not repair a fresh batch: freshInstall() returns before its createTable() loop.
findings.evidence: packages/core/database/migrations/2026_06_13_000009_create_v_blobs_table.php:20-22 still gates on Config::featureEnabled('blobs'); packages/core/src/Schema/SchemaBuilder.php:348-351 foreign-keys file_revision_blobs.blob_id to Config::table('blobs'); packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_000002_rename_storages_to_drives.php:15-17 skips creation on a fresh batch; packages/core/config/vaulter.php:177 exposes blobs as a real toggle defaulting true. The same early return was removed from the other 2026_06_13_000010–000021 shells and from SchemaBuilder::createTable, but not from this file. UPGRADE.md:18-19 and docs/guide/database-compatibility.md:16-17 claim every core table is created regardless of features. CanonicalSchemaTest only calls SchemaBuilder::createAll() after a default-flag migrate, so it never executes this migration with blobs disabled.
